headline: Prabowo-Putin Bertemu 4 Mata di China, Ternyata Bahas Ini
summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto and Russian President Vladimir Putin met at the APEC 2026 summit. They discussed economic cooperation and Indonesia's strategic position in the world.
why: Bilateral economic ties between Indonesia and Russia can influence trade in commodities and energy. Such meetings may lead to future investment or trade agreements.
